title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27
source: Recording Info: Recorded by Kidd at the soundboard - MAR > R > CD; Transfer Info: Mastered via the Apogee Mini Me(24/96) > Mini Dac > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > TLH Flac8; Transferred and Edited By Matt Smith

ai_review.summary: Sublime audience recording with incredible front‑stage sound that captures an energetic Dead show.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the audio, calling it “incredible” and “sublime,” noting that despite being an audience source it places you right in front of the stage. The performance is described as high‑energy and worth grabbing even in its 16‑bit form, with a 24‑bit version also recommended for audiophiles.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and the audio quality; consistent high ratings give strong confidence in a top rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the recording as sublime, clear, and front‑of‑stage, with no noted dropouts or muddiness despite being an audience capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers focus on overall vibe.
